title: Synthesis: dedupe, re-verify, severity-check, final report, PR
objective: Turn the accumulated findings.jsonl into the final audit deliverable a remediation plan can be written from: deduplicated, severity-consistent, every A/B re-verified fresh, coverage stated honestly, refutations preserved. Opens the PR.

steps.do: Entry check: ledger shows pass-1..pass-6 complete. Load findings.jsonl in full. Run node _harness/audit10-findings.js — must be green before anything else.

Dedupe: cluster findings by (url-family, element, phenomenon). Same defect seen by two passes -> keep the richer record, fold the other in via dedupe_note (records are append-only in spirit: mark the folded record with severity unchanged and dedupe_note='folded into A10-xxx' rather than deleting lines). Cross-check every finding against guardrails.json known_issues one final time.

Re-verify EVERY severity A and B finding from a fresh browser context using only the record's own reproduce steps (not your memory). A record whose steps do not reproduce it drops to LIKELY/C and gains a note. This is the audit auditing itself — the prior audits' anti-hallucination incidents all died at this step.

Severity consistency review: sort all findings per level and read each level as a set — do the As all break outcomes? do any Cs read worse than a B? Adjust with severity_rationale updates (append-style edits to the jsonl records are allowed for the fields severity/severity_rationale/dedupe_note in this pass only).

Coverage accounting: from the ledger, a table of what was swept (pages x viewports x dimensions) and what was NOT (sampled anything? skipped state? every candidates.json entry resolved?). Unresolved candidates are listed as unresolved — never silently dropped.

Write _harness/AUDIT10-REPORT.md in the house format (AUDIT-PROMPT-2026-08-09 §8): per-finding blocks for A/B/C (D as an appendix table), then Coverage, [UNVERIFIED] (the php -S set + anything else), Refuted (every refuted candidate/hypothesis with its measurement — as valuable as the findings), Regression state (pass-0's table + a fresh spot re-run of lint + invariants + any suite a finding touches).
Final hygiene: mirror data byte-identical to pristine (cmp), _harness/site/admin/config.local.php deleted, git status clean of everything outside the allowlist, ledger pass-7 complete with pr_url.

Commit 'audit10(pass-7): final report', push, open a ready-for-review PR claude/audit-10 -> main titled 'AUDIT-10: final full-site inspection report', body = the report's summary table + coverage + the three expected regression exceptions called out. The PR body states finding counts per severity and links the in-repo report file.

forbidden_in_this_pass: new sweeps (a gap found here is recorded as a coverage gap, not chased — unless it is a one-URL verification)
exit_criteria: every A/B re-verified with fresh-context evidence
